scenes.text: Have you ever wondered why modern concrete bridges crumble after a few decades, while ancient Roman structures are still standing strong?
For centuries, scientists were baffled by white mineral chunks inside ancient Roman concrete, assuming they were just poor mixing.
But researchers finally discovered these lime clasts actually give the concrete a self-healing ability.
